title: Dinosaur waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#1a3a4a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M25 75 Q10 70 8 55 Q6 45 14 42 Q18 50 20 58 Q24 65 30 68 Z' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <path d='M25 75 Q12 71 10 57 Q9 50 14 46 Q17 53 19 60 Q23 67 29 69 Z' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='74' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#58d68d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='85' width='10' height='10' rx='3' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <rect x='48' y='85' width='10' height='10' rx='3' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='95' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#1e8449'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='95' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#1e8449'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M52 58 Q58 44 62 36' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='12' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='32' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#58d68d'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='35' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='34' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#52be80'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#1e8449'/>
  <!-- mouth / smile -->
  <path d='M70 37 Q73 40 77 37' stroke='#1e8449' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='3.5' fill='#e8f8f5'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='2' fill='#145a32'/>
  <circle cx='67.8' cy='27' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M40 54 L36 44 L43 52 Z' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <path d='M48 52 L46 40 L52 50 Z' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <path d='M56 51 L56 38 L60 49 Z' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <!-- arm down -->
  <path d='M35 68 Q28 72 26 78' stroke='#27ae60' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M58 64 Q68 58 74 48' stroke='#27ae60' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='46' r='5' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <path d='M72 42 L70 37' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M75 41 L75 35' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 42 L80 37' stroke='#2ecc71' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- motion lines for wave -->
  <path d='M85 38 Q88 34 86 30' stroke='#f7dc6f' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M88 44 Q92 40 90 35' stroke='#f7dc6f' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='80' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#82e0aa' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
